turns.style: You are voicing AGENT CROWE, a tall grim government agent in an animated comedy short. Deep, gravelly, slow American voice. He is on a dark rooftop at night, holding up an apple with a small bite out of it in his torch light. Quiet, certain, slow, almost a whisper to himself, like a detective reading a clue.
turns.text: Thrown... from up here. <long pause> Small mouth... big teeth.
